a.text: To be upfront: with an 80% storm chance after every round, the plan to operate until the reserve holds 8 almost certainly ends with both of us dead. The reserve only holds 4, enough for one unit. I intend to take 4 in round 1, which breaks our agreement, and I'd rather tell you now than surprise you. If you also take, the split is random. If you'd rather propose a different fair arrangement, tell me.

b.text: Hello. My plan is to operate each round, then we take 4 each once the reserve is at 8.

a.text: As I said in my opening, I'm taking 4 this round. That breaks our agreement, and I'm sorry it leaves you short. If the episode continues, I'll operate with you so the reserve can rebuild for your unit.
